title: Penthouse July 1987 Jackie Collins Lisa Mondoki Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover clean. Back cover has scattered white specks/ink loss across the image (see photo 2). Spine intact.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, July 1987, original $4.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet: Lisa Mondoki.

Cover features: Heartland heroes - farmers fight back; Jackie Collins - making it in Hollywood; Eat to live - what doctors won't tell you; Last resorts - the ultimate vacation.

Back cover: Lucky Strike Lights cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
